items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 May 2026 11:49am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 30 May 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over central Europe. Large and slow-moving area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 this afternoon and evening, possibly occasionally 6 in central and western areas later this evening and at first tonight. Veering and decreasing West or Southwest 3 or 4 later in night.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate for a time later today and at first tonight.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches at times, patchy rain spreading from the west this afternoon, then becoming fair later tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or mist, occasionally very poor in fog patches. Generally good later tonight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain on Monday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.
